name: unchanged-caller-units
description: store.go changes Touch's ttl from seconds to milliseconds (Expire becomes PExpire). The PR does not touch the caller: the code search finds manager.go passing int64(m.idle.Seconds()), so every session now lives a thousandth of its idle time. The bug is only visible through the reference block, and must be anchored on store.go's diff with the caller line as evidence.

references.text: if err := m.store.Touch(ctx, id, int64(m.idle.Seconds())); err != nil {

expected.why: The unchanged caller still passes seconds to a parameter that now means milliseconds: sessions expire 1000 times too early.
